## Diagnosis

1. The test `testArDelete` in `ArTestCase` is supposed to delete one file from an Ar Archive and verify that only the specified file is deleted.
2. The test first creates an Ar Archive (`bla.ar`) containing two files (`test1.xml` and `test2.xml`).
3. It then attempts to remove all files except `test1.xml` from `bla.ar` and saves the modified archive as `bla2.ar`.
4. The test expects that only one file will be deleted, which is `test2.xml`.
5. However, when the test checks the content of the modified archive file `bla2.ar`, it finds that both `test1.xml` and `test2.xml` are still present.
6. This indicates that the deletion process did not work as expected.

## Possible Cause
The issue might be related to how the deletion logic is implemented when copying entries from one Ar Archive to another. There could be a mistake in the condition or logic that determines which entries to delete.

I will look into the relevant code snippets to identify the potential cause of the incorrect deletion in the `testArDelete` test method.
